messages:
Zoe Park: Quick: can we make a tiny, customer-facing one-pager for prefill + batching + streaming that CS can run in a 10-min call?
Ethan Moore: Yes  keep it super short: 5 actions, 1 curl, 1 jitter rule, 3 plain metrics.
Rina Patel: Metrics: prefill_hit_pct, stream_p95_ms, inflight_count. Give exact alarm numbers so customers can paste.
Caleb Ortiz: Draft five actions: 1) One-off prefill top 8 prompts; 2) Use batch size 2-4; 3) Client timeout 10-12s then streaming fallback; 4) Cache TTLs: ephemeral=5m, session=1h, static=12h; 5) Enable jittered prefill schedule.
Ethan Moore: Copy-paste curl (one-liner):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"tenant":"acme","prompts":["welcome","summary"],"parallel":2}'
```
Jitter: every 5m + rand(-30s..30s).
Rina Patel: Health legend (customer copy): GREEN = prefill_hit_pct >= 75% AND stream_p95_ms < 500ms; YELLOW = prefill_hit_pct 50-75% OR stream_p95_ms 500-800ms; RED = prefill_hit_pct < 50% OR stream_p95_ms > 800ms OR sustained 5xx.
Caleb Ortiz: Renewal note: if RED for 48h -> request temporary warm pool or book troubleshooting call. Public contact: support@redwood.ai.
SupportBot: Draft uploaded to internal docs; remember to strip internals for public copy.
Zoe Park: I'll assemble the one-pager and short email template (subject + 3 bullets). Include tiny feedback widget idea: thumbs up/down + one-line "what changed". Aim to publish to enablement repo by EOD.
Ethan Moore: I can add Grafana alert snippets for customers to paste.
Rina Patel: I'll pin the alarm thresholds into the doc.
Zoe Park: Thanks  concise & actionable. Post final link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
